name: BloodBound
source:
You’re caught between two rival vampire clans – one bathed in light, the other thriving in shadow. You must choose who to trust, who to love, and whose hunger to feed.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你被夾在兩個敵對的吸血鬼氏族之間：一方沐浴在光明中，另一方則在陰影裡壯大。你必須決定該相信誰、愛誰，又要餵飽誰的飢渴。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
